{{Quote|You're not the only one the Council was wrong about, my friend. ''The Jedi have just joined the war against the Mandalorians!''|Ferroh, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
'''Ferroh''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], who were invading Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. In [[3964 BBY]], he and his fellow [[Revanchist]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who were led by the Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], participated in a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Ferroh and the Jedi were [[Ambush on Suurja|ambushed]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] before the [[Fourth battle of Suurja]], and they were taken to [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station|Flashpoint Station]], where they were [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]]. Ferroh and his companions were eventually rescued from captivity by the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], the Mandalorian turncoat [[Rohlan Dyre]], and the other crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[The Last Resort (starship)|''Last Resort'']].

While accompanying the other Revanchists on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]], Ferroh and the Jedi [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] the Mandalorian's [[Battle of Serroco|destruction]] of the planet [[Serroco]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Eventually, a team of Jedi met with the Revanchists on Cathar on behalf of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and ordered them to disband permanently. However, all the Jedi present experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the Mandalorians [[Battle of Cathar|murdering]] the Cathar. The Jedi Council still did not give Revan's Jedi their full support, but Ferroh and the Revanchists were able to participate in the war after Revan organized his followers under the banner of the [[Republic Mercy Corps]].

==Biography==
===Early life and Jedi training===
{{Quote|When I returned, a dozen years ago, my people had simply ''vanished''. ''All'' of them. Only the buildings remained. The Republic assumed a mass migration due to disease&mdash;but offworld, other Cathar refugees told me fragmented tales of harassment by the Mandalorians, who'd hated us since the Sith War.|Ferroh, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
The [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Ferroh was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] during the [[Restoration Period|period]] after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. He eventually left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to undergo [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and later returned to Cathar to discover that all of his people had vanished. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] assumed that the Cathar had migrated due to a disease, but Ferroh learned from Cathar refugees offworld that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], who had hated the Cathar [[Species/Legends|species]] since the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], had beleaguered the planet. Ferroh became convinced that the Mandalorians were responsible for his people's disappearance.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

===Mandalorian Wars===
====Flashpoint Station====
{{Quote|What&mdash;what is this place?"''<br />"''Doctor ''Demagol''{{'s}} waiting room. No appointment necessary."''<br />"''You're all Jedi? What are you doing here?"''<br />"''Captured on Suurja&mdash;ambushed. We were just going to look around, but it's like they knew we were coming. Glorious first outing for the crusading Jedi volunteers, wouldn't you say?|Jarael and Ferroh, in the Flashpoint Station|<ref name="KotOR 8" />}}
[[File:JaraelFerroh-KotOR08.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Ferroh and Jarael inside Flashpoint Station]]
When the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] launched an assault on the Republic and started the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Alek]] were eager to defeat the invading forces. However, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] urged the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to be patient and strictly forbade action against the Mandalorians, feeling that the true threat had not yet emerged. Revan would not be dissuaded, however, and both he and Alek believed that the Order operated too slowly and exercised excessive caution in its decisions. Alek was the first to join Revan's movement, known as the [[Revanchist]]s,<ref name="KotOR CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and other Jedi, including Ferroh,<ref name="KotOR 8" /> soon followed.<ref name="KotOR game">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3964 BBY]], Ferroh was among a group of Jedi that chose to take a more proactive role in the ongoing war by participating in a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], just prior to the Mandalorian invasion of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="KotOR 0">[[Knights of the Old Republic 0|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 0]]</ref> Led by Revan, Ferroh and his fellow Jedi investigated the Mandalorian threat along the Republic border against the wishes of the Jedi Council.<ref name="KotOR 9">[[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]]</ref>

Ferroh and the Revanchists were left behind on the planet [[Suurja]] while Revan departed to investigate events on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and its jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="KotOR 9" /> Ferroh, along with the other Jedi, was captured in an [[Ambush on Suurja|ambush]] before the [[Fourth battle of Suurja]] by the Mandalorians<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 6">[[Knights of the Old Republic 6|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 6]]</ref> and was taken to [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station|Flashpoint Station]], an old Republic research [[Space station/Legends|station]] that the Mandalorians had captured. The Jedi were [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] there by the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]], who was attempting to divine the source and nature of the Jedi's [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]].<ref name="KotOR 8" /> Shortly after the Mandalorians [[Battle of Vanquo|attacked]] the planet [[Vanquo]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 7">[[Knights of the Old Republic 7|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 7]]</ref> the Mandalorian station gained another [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], the female [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|offshoot]] named [[Jarael]], to whom Ferroh explained her location and how he and his fellow Jedi had been previously captured by the Mandalorians. After Alek came out of a torture session with Demagol, Ferroh and the other Jedi attempted to help him stand up, though Alek assured them that he was all right.<ref name="KotOR 8" />

[[File:Hoodedjediandalek.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ferroh, Alek, and their "Master", Revan, sense a great disturbance in the Force.]]
Eventually, the fugitive Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[The Last Resort (starship)|''Last Resort'']] arrived on the station to rescue Jarael. Carrick pretended to be captured by the rogue Mandalorian [[Rohlan Dyre]] and was taken in Jarael's stead to be tortured by Demagol; when Dyre emerged with Demagol, actually Carrick in disguise, they announced that Carrick was [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Shortly after this, the Mandalorians were tricked into leaving the station during a false "Republic attack" masterminded by the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] con artist [[Marn Hierogryph]], one of Carrick's companions. Before they left the station with the incapacitated Demagol in their custody, Ferroh managed to find Carrick's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], returning it to the Padawan.<ref name="KotOR 10">[[Knights of the Old Republic 10|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 10]]</ref> ''En route'' to the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], however, Demagol fell into a drug-induced [[Coma/Legends|coma]] and could not be awakened to stand trial for his crimes.<ref name="KotOR 19">[[Knights of the Old Republic 19|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 19]]</ref> In actuality, Demagol had awoken, drugged Rohlan Dyre, and switched [[Armor/Legends|armors]] with the Mandalorian deserter in order to travel with Jarael, Carrick, and their companions.<ref name="KotOR 47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>

====Vision on Cathar====
{{Quote|We sprang to my people's defense&mdash;but our weapons were useless! Both the attackers and the victims were phantoms&mdash; or ''we'' were! It was a Jedi vision of events from years before&mdash;a vision we were all now sharing!|Ferroh describes the vision of the Battle of Cathar to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
While he and the Revanchists were on the planet Cathar to investigate the truth about the [[Battle of Cathar|massacre]] that had taken place there, Ferroh, Alek, Revan, and the other Jedi [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] death in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] when the Mandalorians unleashed a devastating [[Battle of Serroco|nuclear attack]] on [[Serroco]].<ref name="KotOR 15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> Eventually, Alek, now going by the name "Malak," returned from Coruscant after testifying against the secret organization called the [[Jedi Covenant]] on Zayne Carrick's behalf. Following Malak's return, a team of Jedi loyal to the Council, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vrook Lamar]], met with Revan, Ferroh, Malak, and the Revanchists. They ordered the group to disband permanently, believing that the Mandalorians were not a threat and that nothing warranted the Jedi's involvement in the Mandalorian Wars. During the discussion, Revan noticed a [[Revan's mask|Mandalorian mask]] underneath his own feet and picked it up.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

[[File:RevanIsBorn-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Ferroh, Malak, and their fellow Jedi look on as Revan vows to defeat the Mandalorians.]]
When the light struck the mask, all the Jedi experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the past of Mandalorians driving hordes of the Cathar into the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. A [[Unidentified Mandalorian female|Mandalorian female]], to whom the mask in Revan's hands belonged, tried to convince [[Cassus Fett]]&mdash;the Mandalorian who had led the attack on the planet&mdash;that the Cathar were defeated and did not all need to be killed. However, Fett refused to stand down, saying that the Cathar left a stain of dishonor amongst the ''Mando'ade'' and that he intended to wash that stain clean by committing [[Speciecide|genocide]]. Fett then ordered the planet's devastation, killing the Cathar and the Mandalorian female.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

After the vision ended, Revan became enraged, shouting that the Mandalorians' massacre of the already beaten Cathar had not been warranted. Recognizing that the lone Mandalorian female knew that the genocide had been wrong, Revan decided to take up her cause of protecting innocents from unnecessary destruction. As Ferroh, Malak, and the other Jedi watched, Revan donned the Mandalorian female's mask, vowing not to remove it until there was justice against the Mandalorians&mdash;specifically, their defeat.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> Despite knowing the truth of what had happened on Cathar, the Jedi still did not give their full support to Revan. However, with Revan's reorganization of the Revanchists under the banner of a [[Republic Mercy Corps]], the Jedi Council allowed Revan, Malak, Ferroh, and their like-minded comrades to participate in the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="KotOR 49">[[Knights of the Old Republic 49|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 49]]</ref>

====Reunion on Wor Tandell====
{{Quote|Malak, stop! ''He's beaten! You don't have to do this!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Ferroh, to Malak, regarding the beaten "Rohlan Dyre"|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
Ferroh eventually went to the planet [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]], along with Malak and the Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Telettoh]], to search for Zayne Carrick<ref name="KotOR 42" />&mdash;who had been found innocent of the crimes charged against him<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 35">[[Knights of the Old Republic 35|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 35]]</ref>&mdash;and his friends. He found Carrick in Wor Tandell's capital [[City/Legends|town]], [[Gantra Lea]], and introduced Telettoh to the former Padawan. Carrick expressed his relief, stating that he had thought that Ferroh was in the Captain's custody. When Carrick expressed his disbelief to Ferroh's announcement of the Jedi's involvement in the Mandalorian Wars, Ferroh told the former Jedi of his past, and of the vision he and the Revanchists had experienced on Cathar. Ferroh, Carrick, and Telettoh eventually made their way to Carrick's camp.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

[[File:TelletohMalakFerroh-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Ferroh and Telettoh break up the fight between Malak and "Rohlan Dyre" on Wor Tandell.]]
There, they found Malak, who was trying to convince Jarael to join him and the Revanchists, fighting Demagol&mdash;whom both Jedi believed to be Rohlan Dyre. Ferroh and Telettoh broke up the fight between Malak and Demagol when the former defeated the latter. After Malak briefly conversed with Jarael and Carrick, Ferroh, Malak, and Telettoh left the planet to continue fighting the war.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

Eventually, Rohlan Dyre&mdash;whom Malak, Ferroh, and the Republic still believed to be Demagol because of the armor switch&mdash;came out of his drug-induced coma<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 45">[[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]]</ref> and stood [[Trial of Demagol|trial]] on Coruscant for Demagol's crimes against the Republic.<ref name="KotOR 47" /> Sometime after the trial ended, Malak learned that "Demagol" had not made it back to his holding cell, and Ferroh assisted Malak in the search for the scientist on Coruscant.<ref name="KotOR 48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref> Although both the real Demagol and [[the Crucible]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization were [[Duel on Osadia|defeated]] on the planet [[Osadia]] by Rohlan Dyre, Jarael, and Carrick,<ref name="KotOR 50">[[Knights of the Old Republic 50|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 50]]</ref> the search for Demagol was not called off by the Republic authorities.<ref>{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=238483|thread=KNIGHTS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC #50 -- My only friend, the end!|user=John Jackson Miller|date=2010-02-17|time=19:56|nobackup=1}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The Cathar male Ferroh wore [[brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]<ref name="KotOR 8" /> and used a lightsaber containing a [[blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="KotOR 42" /> When he returned to his homeworld, Cathar refugees told him that the Mandalorians had harassed the planet before, causing him to suspect that the Mandalorians had something to do with the Cathar species' disappearance.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> In 3964 BBY, Ferroh was among a number of Jedi who were eager to defend the Republic when the Mandalorians attacked. Ferroh was willing to defy the Jedi Council's orders during the war in the face of the Revanchists' cause by participating in a scouting mission on the Republic's behalf.<ref name="KotOR 8" /> After the Jedi Council sanctioned the Revanchists' involvement in the war, he was excited to relate the Council's decision to Zayne Carrick.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

Ferroh was courteous enough to inform Jarael that she was in Flashpoint Station when she arrived there, and he also attempted to assist Malak when the latter returned from a torture session with Demagol.<ref name="KotOR 8" /> He expressed his gratitude to Carrick after the fugitive Jedi and his companions rescued him and the other captive Jedi from the Mandalorians.<ref name="KotOR 10" /> While he and the Revanchists were on Cathar searching for evidence of the Mandalorian atrocities, Ferroh, along with his fellow Jedi, were persistent and did not give up in their efforts to find this information. Following Malak's defeat of Demagol, who was believed to be Rohlan Dyre, Ferroh did not agree with Malak's actions when he continued to fight Demagol. He argued this point to his fellow Jedi as he and Telettoh restrained Malak from inflicting further damage on the Mandalorian.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

==Powers and abilities==
Ferroh was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to the Force and was deemed suitable for Jedi training.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> While on Cathar with the Revanchists, Ferroh felt the Mandalorians' devastation of the planet Serroco through the Force.<ref name="KotOR 15" /> He later witnessed a vision of the Mandalorians' slaughter of the Cathar people.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ferroh was created by [[John Jackson Miller]], the writer of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]]. He first appeared in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 8|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Flashpoint|''Flashpoint'']] story arc, and was also in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 10|third and final comic]] of the arc. Ferroh later appeared in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|third issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Days of Fear|''Days of Fear'']] story arc, and was featured more prominently in the standalone [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Masks'']], the series' forty-second issue. He additionally appeared in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 48|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon|''Demon'']] story arc. He was drawn by [[Dustin Weaver]] for the eighth, tenth, and fifteenth issues, and was penciled by [[Ron Chan]] in the forty-second issue. In the forty-eighth issue, Ferroh was drawn by [[Brian Ching]].

In ''Masks'', Ferroh tells Zayne Carrick that he returned to Cathar "a dozen years" before 3963 BBY, the year in which the comic takes place.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> John Jackson Miller stated in his production notes for the forty-second issue that this was two years after the date that appeared for the Battle of Cathar in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''. Miller said that the more specific date that appears in the campaign guide, [[3973 BBY]], is the correct one.<ref name="KotOR CG" /><ref name="Notes on KotOR 42">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor42.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #42''}}</ref> The date that Miller gives in his production notes for ''Masks'', 3975 BBY, is actually two years before the Battle of Cathar.<ref name="Notes on KotOR 42" />
